definition: Model-derived upper forest-floor load using Finney-Martin cumulative model 3 and the estimated litter-depth boundary. Negative shallow-layer extrapolations are bounded at zero and retained in the station-level audit output.

Model-derived lower forest-floor load: total Finney-Martin forest-floor load minus modeled litter load. Two shallow estimated litter layers were bounded at zero after the equation returned negative mass.
1-hour dead and downed woody fuel load (diameter < 0.635 cm), carried forward unchanged from the thesis line-intercept calculation.
10-hour dead and downed woody fuel load (diameter 0.635-2.54 cm), carried forward unchanged from the thesis line-intercept calculation.
100-hour dead and downed woody fuel load (diameter 2.54-7.62 cm), carried forward unchanged from the thesis line-intercept calculation.
1000-hour dead and downed woody fuel load (diameter > 7.62 cm), combining sound and rotten wood; carried forward unchanged from the thesis line-intercept calculation.
FireMon-style cover-height estimate using the existing woody bulk-density constant.
FireMon-style cover-height estimate using the existing herbaceous bulk-density constant.
Pre-PCT minus post-PCT woody standing vegetation; inferred potential surface-fuel contribution, not direct slash load.
Recorded field value; do not interpret as slash depth until protocol comparability is confirmed.
